title: update-readme-images configuration
description: Configuration schema for the update-readme-images skill and CLI tool. Defines GNOX-namespaced style guides (workspace_root:subdir:...), glob-matched rules documents (*, **), automatic og-social-image generation for web-standard assets/images directories, and non-destructive assets/drafts staging for existing images.

workspace_root.description: Canonical workspace root identifier used as the leading segment in workspace_root:subdir:... namespace keys.

default_assets_dir.description: Web-standard relative directory (from a root or subdirectory) where live rendered panel images are stored.

draft_assets_dir.description: Relative directory under assets/ where candidate replacements for existing images are staged pending asynchronous user approval.

draft_revision_policy.description: Non-destructive revision gate governing existing images. Existing files in assets/images are never overwritten directly; candidates are staged in draft_assets_dir and promoted only after explicit user approval.

auto_og_social_image.description: Automatic og-social-image generation within any directory or subdirectory using the web-standard assets/images directory, unless explicitly disabled here, per-namespace, or when ImageMagick (magick) is unavailable and not installable via mise.

overrides.description: Per-directory or per-namespace crop/framing overrides (e.g. gravity: 'north', crop_offset: '+0+10').

style_guides.description: Map of workspace_root:subdir:... namespace keys (or '*' fallback) to style guide configurations. Child namespaces inherit from parent namespaces along the colon-delimited path unless inherit is false.

doc.description: Repo-relative path to the Markdown style guide document.

inherit.description: When true (default), merges parent style guides from workspace_root down to the most specific matching subdir namespace.

og_social_image.description: Optional per-namespace override to explicitly disable (false) or enable (true) automatic og-social-image generation in this namespace.

reference_images.description: Repo-relative paths to visual anchor images passed in ImagePaths during image generation to prevent style drift.

rules.description: Ordered list of global and path-targeted image inclusion rules matched against repo-relative file paths using standard glob (*, **, ?) notation.

glob.description: Glob pattern(s) matched against normalized repo-relative paths (e.g. 'README.md', 'plugins/*/README.md', 'plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md').

doc.description: Repo-relative path to the Markdown rules document explaining how and what panel images must be included for files matching this glob.

section_heading.description: Target Markdown heading (e.g. '## Skills', '## Contents', '## Config', '## What you get', '## Credits') when placement is section-relative.

bullet_match.description: Substring or regex to locate the bullet line when placement is 'after-bullet-matching'.

src_pattern.description: Relative image path pattern supporting placeholders: {repo}, {dir_name}, {plugin}, {skill}, {file_stem}.

width.description: Display width in px when using HTML embed styles (e.g. 260 for oval tribute insets).
